description.p: Lave Station is a GTK interface to the Docker daemon on your own machine. It speaks the daemon's API directly rather than driving the command line tool.

The sidebar lists the images and containers on this device, running and stopped. Selecting anything shows its metadata, and the root of the tree reports the local Docker environment itself: the endpoint in use, the negotiated API version, the storage driver, and the cgroup configuration.
The window stays up to date by subscribing to the daemon's event stream, and a panel indicator reports the connection while the window is closed.
First iteration: the window, the tree of images and containers, and the environment overview.
